result.details: Published target dependencies resolved; --fix applies them with guarded undo.

features.input: Gradle mod source checkout with a wrapper; a compiled mod JAR is not source

features.name: automatic-target
features.scope: One selected Fabric project, version properties with one owner, verifiable published dependencies and mappings; multi-project orchestration remains unfinished

features.name: dependency-selection
features.scope: Automatic identity, then an explicit selection file whose target coordinate, published repository and target-game support are verified; optional dependencies can be disabled with proof and a reason

features.name: dependency-blockers
features.scope: Unresolved dependencies stop before edits and name the selection entry to add

features.name: other-loader-target
features.scope: NeoForge version pins, loader version and declared game range resolve and rewrite; a real NeoForge mod built, loaded and ran its command on the target. Forge target setup remains manual, and larger jumps stop with the named API families that remain

features.name: api-migration
features.scope: Verified mappings and recognized recipes; unfamiliar semantic changes need guided repair

features.name: build-and-mixin
features.scope: Port runs the evaluated build, then Mixin itself applies every mixin against the target game (Fabric Knot, or NeoForge FML's unit-test launch); no window, no world

features.name: safe-undo
features.scope: Restores recorded original bytes; refuses to overwrite subsequent edits

features.name: logic-tests
features.scope: fast runs supplied JUnit 5 tests: every test when no Minecraft or loader is on the test classpath (plain Java, Paper plugins), otherwise only tests tagged pure; absent tests fail with the reason, and tests are not generated

features.name: plugin-check
features.scope: Paper/Bukkit plugins: plugin-check loads the built jar on MockBukkit (a fake Paper server) for the plugin's Paper API line and checks the descriptor, main class, onEnable, command handlers, permissions, listeners and hard dependencies; server internals are unchecked, and no real server runs

features.name: server-check
features.scope: Paper plugins on a real headless Paper server (downloaded from PaperMC, offline, local only) with a protocol bot player: a scenario of chat, commands and RCON with expect steps on chat, titles, the server log, HTTP, entities, blocks, inventory and position; secrets masked; the bot speaks 26.3 (knowledge/mcprotocollib.json) and joins any other Paper version through ViaProxy (knowledge/viaproxy.json)

features.name: game-behavior
features.scope: ui-check and world-check capture the actual game; a meaningful assertion is required for behaviorVerified=true

features.name: visual-change
features.scope: ui-check/world-check --expect-change PERCENT fails when the key, click or screen changes too little of the real frame; it caught the invisible F3Nope overlay that a passing build missed

features.name: save-roundtrip
features.scope: world-check --save-roundtrip quits to the title, reloads the same save and requires the player position to come back within 0.05 blocks

features.name: game-console
features.scope: eval runs a Java snippet inside the owned client and returns its value in about a second; verified on Fabric 26.3

features.name: portable-hot-reload
features.scope: reload recompiles and redefines changed classes in the owned client and reloads resources; method bodies on a stock JVM, added methods and fields with --jbr; mixins and mod metadata still need a restart; verified on Fabric 26.3

features.name: operating-systems
features.scope: Windows command and game checks; Windows, Linux and macOS portable checks pass in hosted CI; Linux and macOS game rendering unverified

features.name: installation
features.scope: Portable ZIP and JAR; a Windows machine with no Java downloads a verified JRE or JDK once; macOS and Linux still need Java installed
